title: Return from a procedure call
statement: Let a compiled program have word size $W$, and let its memory $m$ represent a light-program state $\sigma$ at stack depth $q+F+1$. Suppose the code at position $\mathrm{pos}$ begins with the procedure epilogue, the return-address cell at stack position $q+F$ contains the word encoding $\mathrm{ret}$, $\mathrm{ret}<\mathrm{disp}$, $q+F+1\le Q$, and $0<F$. Then after $5+2(\mathrm{ret}+1)$ machine steps, the program can reach program counter $\mathrm{ret}$ with a memory $m'$ whose frame pointer contains the word encoding the stack position $q$ and whose return register contains the word encoding $\sigma.loc(0)$. The memories $m$ and $m'$ agree at every address outside the union of the frame-pointer address and the scratch-address set for $F$.
